note: the fill's patch search marks every pixel as a source centre, so patches are allowed inside the hole and the fill copies the hole's own pixels, caught by FillFromSurroundingsTests.neverCopiesFromHole
the fill skips the heal step and keeps each match's raw tone, so the fill does not meet the ring where its tone varies, caught by FillFromSurroundingsTests.toneMeetsRing
the fill's search ignores its seed and always starts from a fixed state, so every seed gives the same fill, caught by FillFromSurroundingsTests.seedChangesFill
the patch search keeps the worse-matching candidate instead of the better one, so the hole fills with the least similar texture, caught by FillFromSurroundingsTests.picksBestMatch
anchor: if d < bestD { (best, bestD) = (cy * width + cx, d) }
replacement: if d > bestD { (best, bestD) = (cy * width + cx, d) }

note: the fill's size limit on its search window lets twice maxHealPixels through, so a sparse mask over the cap is searched and healed instead of throwing, caught by FillFromSurroundingsTests.sparseMaskOverCapThrowsEarly
the fill ignores a feathered mask's coverage and writes the full fill on partly covered pixels, caught by FillFromSurroundingsTests.featherBlendsByCoverage

the fill's heal guides by the filled source's own steps instead of its matches' steps, so the seams between matches of different tone stay in the fill, caught by FillFromSurroundingsTests.toneMeetsRing

note: the fill's search window ignores the mask's bounds and spans the whole buffer, so a small spot's work grows with the photo, caught by FillFromSurroundingsTests.workScalesWithMaskNotBuffer

the fill's search window drops the half-side term and adds only r + 32 around a large hole, so a hole whose window holds more than maxHealPixels is searched with too little context instead of throwing, caught by FillFromSurroundingsTests.searchWindowGrowsWithHole
anchor: let margin = r + max(Self.fillContext, max(box.width, box.height) / 2)

note: the fill pyramid drops from three levels to one, so the search finds no long structure to carry across the hole, caught by FillFromSurroundingsTests.keepsStructureAcrossHole
the patch search runs one iteration per level instead of five, so matches stay near their random start, caught by FillFromSurroundingsTests.keepsStructureAcrossHole

note: the fill's guidance between two hole pixels no longer takes the smaller of the two sources' steps, so seams between sources of different tone stay, caught by FillFromSurroundingsTests.fillsWhereNoTranslationFits
